<style>
.print-note { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #6b6b6b; margin: 0 0 1rem; }
.sheetwrap { max-width: 8in; margin: 0 auto; }
.cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.13in;
}
.card {
  border: 1px dashed #9a9a94;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.14in 0.16in;
  min-height: 2.85in;
  break-inside: avoid;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.card .n { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b31b1b; font-weight: 700; }
.card h3 { font-size: 0.94rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0.12rem 0 0.4rem; line-height: 1.2; border: none; }
.card dl { margin: 0; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.42; }
.card dt { font-weight: 700; color: #55554f; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
.card dd { margin: 0 0 0 0; color: #333; }
.card .joins { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.35rem; border-top: 1px solid #e3e3de; font-size: 0.7rem; }
.card .joins b { color: #b31b1b; }

/* The rotating question sheet, one per group. */
.qsheet { border: 1px solid #55554f; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.28in; margin-top: 0.3in; break-inside: avoid; }
.qsheet h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; border: none; }
.qsheet .row { border-bottom: 1px solid #cfcfc9; min-height: 0.42in; margin-bottom: 0.16in; }
.qsheet .lbl { font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #6b6b6b; font-weight: 700; }
.qsheet .filters { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #333; line-height: 1.5; }
.pagebreak { break-before: page; }

@media print {
  .print-note, #quarto-header, #quarto-sidebar, .nav-page, footer, #quarto-margin-sidebar { display: none !important; }
  @page { size: letter portrait; margin: 0.4in; }
  body { background: #fff; }
  .sheetwrap { max-width: none; }
}
</style>

<p class="print-note">Print this page. Nine cards, one per group — cut along

<div class="sheetwrap">

      <dt>Coverage</dt><dd>United States</dd>
      <dt>Carries</dt><dd>Ratings 1–100 for heat, precipitation, drought, flooding, fire</dd>
    </dl>
    <div class="joins">Joins on <b>ZIP</b></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">

      <dt>Coverage</dt><dd>US &amp; Canada, 2017 to now</dd>
      <dt>Carries</dt><dd>Visit and visitor counts, visitor home areas, dwell time</dd>
    </dl>
    <div class="joins">Joins on <b>lat/long · brand · NAICS</b></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">

    <div class="joins">Joins on <b>lat/long · ZIP</b></div>

  <div class="card">
